name: ultra.questioning
description: ULTRA Questioning studio: is this question worth asking Mike at all, and is the angle taxonomy actually resolved? Polarity is mixed and stated per question. Signals are named in studios/questioning/STUDIO.md; `q.duplicate_of` is DEFERRED (needs a per-call dynamic option list the static registry cannot carry; dedup stays code normalization).

shape.instructions: What kind of thing is this question

criteria.decision: only the human owner can answer this
criteria.fact: looking it up would answer it
criteria.assumption: nobody has answered it and the plan is proceeding as if it were true
criteria.noise: answering it would not change the build

decision_critical.instructions: Answering this question could change what we build or whether we build it.

leading.instructions: This question presupposes its own answer or steers the respondent to one option.

cls.instructions: Which angle class does this question belong to

criteria.customer_job: who is this for and what job does it do
criteria.buyer_money: who pays, from what budget, against what alternative spend
criteria.competitor_landscape: who else is doing this or something like it
criteria.technical_feasibility: can it actually be built with the models, data and hands available
criteria.distribution_channel: how does it reach the person who needs it
criteria.timing_why_now: why this month rather than next year
criteria.legal_compliance: what law, contract or policy constrains it
criteria.people_capacity: who does the work and what do they stop doing
criteria.failure_modes: how this dies in a way we can foresee
criteria.exit_kill: what would make us stop, and who decides
criteria.measurement: how we would know it worked
criteria.dependencies_assumptions: what has to be true elsewhere for this to hold
criteria.ethics_reputation: what we would not want on a screen in a court

class_resolved.instructions: Every decision-critical unknown in this angle class has an answer or a named probe on record.

is_decision.instructions: This question can only be answered by the human owner; looking harder would not answer it.

rules.reason: noise question: would not change the build if answered
a fact to look up, not a question for the human: route to Research
low value of information: park rather than spend a human decision
leading question: the card would manufacture agreement
looks answerable by research; send it to Research before asking
angle class not resolved: coverage cannot be claimed for it

notes.shape: doc signal q.shape. 'fact' and 'noise' block the card, not the mission.
notes.cls: doc signal q.class; the 14 options are the angle taxonomy and must stay in step with coverage meter code.
notes.class_resolved: doc signal q.class_resolved; coverage is COMPUTED from this answer over 14 calls, never asked directly.
notes.is_decision: doc signal card.is_decision; a card reaches Mike only above the threshold.
